abbi woods.bio: Toronto R&B singer-songwriter ABBI WOODS draws on her upbringing in the city and her Ethiopian and Eritrean roots to make intimate, emotionally ambivalent music about identity, relationships and self-discovery. She emerged in 2025 with singles including HBD, Scattered Bodies and TOO LATE, building a contemporary soul sound around candid writing and atmospheric production.

allie.bio: Allie is the library credit for Toronto R&B singer-songwriter Allison Ho-Sang, who records as a l l i e. Her atmospheric blend of soul, electronic music and pop has earned SOCAN Songwriting Prize recognition, a Polaris Music Prize longlist and a JUNO nomination, while collaborations include Illa J and Canadian production duo Potatohead People on Sunflower.

lindo p.bio: Lindo P, also known as Lindissimo, is a Canadian reggae and dancehall DJ, selector, recording artist and songwriter based in Toronto. Originally from St. Ann, Jamaica, he immigrated to Toronto with his family and became embedded in the city's Canadian-Caribbean music community through 416 Sound, solo releases and collaborations with artists including Kardinal Offishall and Shawn Desman.

manna music.bio: Manna Music is a Canadian producer, songwriter and creative director working at the intersection of Punjabi music, hip-hop and pop. After first building an audience through remixes and DJ work, he moved into music direction and production with artists including Karan Aujla, Deep Jandu, DIVINE and Inderpal Moga, while also founding Double M Records and earning Canadian industry recognition including a JUNO nomination.

nilla.bio: Galyn Esmé, better known as NiLLa, is a Canadian hip-hop emcee, producer, educator and photographer based in Toronto. Active for more than 15 years, she built a reputation for conscious lyricism and self-produced music, won Rap/Hip-Hop Recording of the Year at the Hamilton Music Awards for From the Ground UP and has performed across Canada and Europe.
